title: The Midnight Choir
author: Silas Okafor
blurb: Dominic Oyelaran, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
